label: Delhi NCR
tagline: Mughal monuments, street food and museums.

hotels.name: Madpackers Hostel
hotels.note: Popular backpacker hostel with a courtyard cafe, metro nearby.

hotels.name: Hotel City Star
hotels.note: Basic but clean and very central for the railway station and Connaught Place.

hotels.name: Bloomrooms @ New Delhi Station
hotels.note: Compact modern rooms with strong wifi; walk to the Airport Express.

hotels.name: The Claridges
hotels.note: Elegant colonial-era hotel with lawns, close to India Gate.

hotels.name: The Lodhi
hotels.note: Contemporary rooms with private plunge pools; overlooks Lodhi Gardens.

hotels.name: Haveli Dharampura
hotels.note: Restored 19th-century haveli inside the old city lanes; rooftop views of Jama Masjid.

things_to_do.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
things_to_do.note: Mughal fortress of red sandstone; the sound-and-light show runs in the evening.

things_to_do.name: Qutub Minar
things_to_do.note: 73 m victory tower from 1199 with an intricately carved iron pillar.

things_to_do.name: Humayun's Tomb
things_to_do.note: The garden-tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal; lovely at golden hour.

things_to_do.name: India Gate and Rajpath
things_to_do.note: War memorial arch on the ceremonial avenue; best after dark when lit.

things_to_do.name: Chandni Chowk cycle-rickshaw ride
things_to_do.note: Thread the spice and silver lanes by rickshaw; the paratha galli is en route.

things_to_do.name: Lodhi Art District walk
things_to_do.note: India's first open-air public art district, painted on the block walls.

eateries.name: Karim's
eateries.must_try: Mutton korma, seekh kebab and sheermal
eateries.note: Mughlai institution near Jama Masjid, serving since 1913.

eateries.name: Paranthe Wali Gali
eateries.must_try: Stuffed paranthas, including rabri and banana
eateries.note: The famous lane of stuffed paratha shops; go hungry and share.

eateries.name: Saravana Bhavan
eateries.must_try: Ghee roast dosa and filter coffee
eateries.note: Dependable South Indian vegetarian; quick and air-conditioned.

eateries.name: Bukhara
eateries.note: Legendary North-West Frontier grill; reserve well ahead.
